items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Lenny was the drummer and my son played the, ‘cause they had a little band.

ctx.x: Okay, see they were all in this thing, I think Lenny was the drummer and my son played the, ‘cause they had a little band. Well, I went to the concert, my wife and I, went over there and I, “He’s serious.” So I got him a teacher, I got him, I got him a, my son, grandson. And I loved the way that this teacher taught him, he taught him how to play first. He didn’t start him on scales.
